description: Self-contained numbered list item. Renders its sequential number (computed by the parent by counting preceding sibling NumberedList blocks at the same indent level). Enter on an empty item fires OnTypeConvert("paragraph"). Enter on a non-empty item fires OnEnterSplit to create a new sibling. Tab/Shift+Tab fires OnIndentChange so the parent can clamp (0–3) and persist.

parameters.name: OnContentSaved
parameters.description: Fired on blur when HTML has changed. Arg = new HTML.

parameters.name: OnDeleteRequested
parameters.description: Fired when Backspace is pressed on an empty item.

parameters.name: OnEnterSplit
parameters.description: Fired when Enter is pressed on a non-empty item. Arg = HTML after the split point.

parameters.name: OnFocused
parameters.description: Fired when the editable receives focus.

parameters.name: OnIndentChange
parameters.description: Fired when Tab / Shift+Tab. Bool = shiftKey (true = outdent).

parameters.name: OnMentionMenu
parameters.description: Fired when '@' is typed. Args = (top, left) caret coords.

parameters.name: OnPageLinkMenu
parameters.description: Fired when '[[' is typed. Args = (top, left) caret coords.

parameters.name: OnSlashMenu
parameters.description: Fired when '/' is typed. Args = (top, left) caret coords.

parameters.name: OnTokenMenu
parameters.description: Fired when '{{' token syntax is typed. Args = (top, left) caret coords.

parameters.name: OnTypeConvert
parameters.description: Fired when a markdown or conversion shortcut is detected. Special value "paragraph" means the user pressed Enter on an empty item.
